name: Select
title: Components/Inputs & Selection/Select
description: A single-selection Base UI listbox with labeled groups, descriptive options, icons, typeahead, Arrow/Home/End navigation, Escape dismissal and native form participation. Values must be nonempty strings.
purpose: Choose one value from a labeled list of options.
usage: Options support icons, descriptions, groups, and disabled states. Use Field for shared validation text.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
